summary: Re-verification of the hardened palm-rejection fix in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx. Static wiring matches spec exactly (strictest 'Pen only' check), and full smoke/regression on the Expo web preview passes with zero page errors. Frontend only — backend untouched.

static_wiring_checks.isStylus_definition_correct: PASS — `const isStylus = toolType === 2 || toolType === 4 || pointerType === 'stylus' || pointerType === 'pen';` (lines 426-430)
static_wiring_checks.isFinger_variable_removed: PASS — grep across /app/frontend returns 0 matches for `isFinger`
static_wiring_checks.isStylusRef_declared_and_used: PASS — declared at line 414 (useRef<boolean>(true)), consulted in onBegin (442), onUpdate (459), onEnd (476)
static_wiring_checks.set_only_when_not_rejecting: PASS — `isStylusRef.current = isStylus || (toolType === undefined && pointerType === undefined);` only runs when the early-return above did NOT fire (line 439)

smoke_regression_checks.fab_to_handwriting_to_start_writing: PASS — navigates to /draw/<uuid>, 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors
smoke_regression_checks.tool_pen_mode_present_and_toggles: PASS — initial label 'Touch on' → tap → 'Pen only' → tap → 'Touch on' (active state visually green when on)
smoke_regression_checks.draw_more_kebab_rows: PASS — all 10 expected rows present: Page color, Page template, Page size, Toolbar position, Rename, Settings, Undo, Redo, Clear (rendered as 'Clear canvas'), Move to trash
smoke_regression_checks.draw_menu_toolbar_picker: PASS — 4-card picker (Left / Right / Top / Bottom) opens. Selecting Right applied without crash; menu closes and 'Toolbar position' row reflects new value. (Note: the `draw-menu-toolbar` testID lives on the kebab ROW that opens the picker, not on the sub-modal itself — confirmed in code at line 1059.)
smoke_regression_checks.text_note_top_tabs_row: PASS — /note/<id> renders Chrome-style OpenTabsStrip with both open tabs visible (Handwritten note + Untitled), plus `back-btn`, `pin-btn`, `more-btn` in the header. (testIDs are `back-btn`/`pin-btn`/`more-btn`, not `note-back`/`note-pin`/`note-more` — naming difference only, functionality intact.)

explicit_callouts: WEB FALLBACK LIMITATION: The /draw/ screen shows the 'Stylus / S Pen canvas — Open this note on Android or iOS in Expo Go to draw with full pressure-aware stylus support.' placeholder in the web preview. Browser cannot simulate Android `toolType` values (UNKNOWN/finger/stylus/eraser), so the actual rejection branch in onTouchesDown is NOT exercised by Playwright.

USER MUST INSTALL A FRESH NATIVE BUILD on the Samsung S25 Ultra to confirm that 'Pen only' mode now blocks finger drawing under real Android touch events. The web preview can only verify wiring + UI surface, not the gesture-level rejection.
action_items: Ship a fresh native (development) build to the S25 Ultra and verify: (a) with 'Pen only' ON, finger drags produce zero strokes and no live preview; (b) S Pen still draws normally; (c) toggling to 'Touch on' restores finger drawing.

Optional polish: console still emits deprecation warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking — RN-web internals — but worth tracking.
critical_code_review_comments: Palm-rejection branch in onTouchesDown is now strictly 'pen-only when ON' which matches the spec; isStylusRef is the single source of truth and is consulted in every subsequent callback (onBegin/onUpdate/onEnd) — defensive design is correct.
Edge case correctly handled: when both `toolType` AND `pointerType` are undefined (e.g. web preview / very old Android), and palm rejection is OFF, the ref defaults to true so drawing still works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verified the hardened palm-rejection logic in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx onTouchesDown. Strict 'Pen only' check is wired correctly (toolType 2/4 OR pointerType 'stylus'/'pen' required). FAB testID is `fab-create-note`; handwriting entry is text 'Handwriting / S Pen' which opens a setup dialog requiring tap on 'Start writing' to navigate. Note screen header testIDs are `back-btn`, `pin-btn`, `more-btn` (not prefixed). Web preview cannot simulate Android toolType — gesture-level rejection must be validated on a real S Pen device.
